<div class="ap-chain r"> <div class="ap-cnode"> <span class="cy">2023.06 – 2024.08</span> <b>An autonomous commercial vehicle company</b> <p>The starting point. The same analysis, every day, all by hand.</p> </div> <div class="ap-cnode"> <span class="cy">2024 – 2025</span> <b>Dify consulting assistant</b> <p>After leaving, I redid the same workflow with multiple agents.</p> </div> <div class="ap-cnode hi"> <span class="cy">2025 – now</span> <b>NL2SQL Agent</b> <p>The platform wasn't controllable enough — so I built the core query pipeline myself.</p> </div> <div class="ap-cnode"> <span class="cy">2025.09 – 2026.04</span> <b>LeadX</b> <p>Took that toolkit to a startup and built a full-stack SaaS.</p> </div> </div> <p class="ap-works-tag r">The deliverables kept leveling up too: dashboards → libraries → systems → products.</p> See more
